National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) Standard Operating Procedures

Official multi-tier emergency response protocols for North Eastern Region landslide disasters (ISO 22320 Compliant)

LEVEL 0 · NORMAL (GREEN)
Threshold: Rainfall < 50mm/24h. Factor of Safety (FoS) > 1.5.
  • Routine in-situ telemetry checks
  • Weep hole clearing along NH corridors
  • Weekly NLSM satellite verification
LEVEL 1 · WATCH (YELLOW)
Threshold: 50mm - 90mm/24h. FoS between 1.3 and 1.5.
  • Increase piezometer sampling to 5 mins
  • Alert local PWD and BRO clearing units
  • Issue advisory to heavy transport vehicles
LEVEL 2 · ALERT (AMBER)
Threshold: 90mm - 130mm/24h. FoS between 1.0 and 1.3.
  • Deploy SDRF quick response teams
  • Prepare designated relief shelters
  • SMS cell broadcast to danger perimeter
LEVEL 3 · EVACUATION (RED)
Threshold: > 130mm/24h or shear rate > 3mm/h. FoS < 1.0.
  • Mandatory evacuation of corridor
  • Close automated traffic barrier gates
  • Mobilize NDRF 1st Bn search & rescue

The North Eastern Region Landslide Early Warning System (NER-LEWS 2.0) is a scientific disaster mitigation initiative deployed in coordination with the Geological Survey of India (GSI), India Meteorological Department (IMD), and North Eastern Space Applications Centre (NESAC).
